products.title: Extendable Interior Windshield Cleaner
products.blurb: Reach the bottom corners of your windshield without contorting yourself.
features: Telescoping aluminum pole with a 180° pivoting head reaches every corner of the glass
Washable, reusable microfiber pads lift haze, film and fog with no streaks
Comfortable foam grip; extra washable pads included
Works on cars, trucks, SUVs, RVs and home windows

products.title: Telescoping Magnetic Pickup Tool with LED Light
products.blurb: Grab dropped screws, nuts and bolts from engine bays and under furniture.
features: Extends from about 7.5 in to 31.5 in to reach tight, deep spots
Strong magnet head holds up to 8 lb of hardware
Built-in LED lights up dark engine bays and under-seat spots
Soft anti-slip handle with pocket clip

products.title: Extendable Snow Brush with Ice Scraper
products.blurb: Clear the whole roof and windshield in one pass, then chip off the ice.
features: Extends from about 29 in to 42 in to reach roofs of SUVs and trucks
Brush head rotates 360° and locks for pushing or pulling snow
Sharp chisel-edge ice scraper with crusher teeth on the other end
Foam grips stay comfortable in freezing weather

products.title: Magnetic Windshield Snow & Ice Cover
products.blurb: Skip the morning scrape. Lift the cover and drive.
features: Thick Oxford fabric blocks snow, ice and frost from the windshield
6 magnets plus elastic hooks hold it in place in wind
Mirror covers included; about 102 x 45 in fits most cars and SUVs
Doubles as a summer sunshade; folds into a storage pouch

products.title: Silicone Lick Mat & Slow Feeder for Dogs and Cats
products.blurb: Calms anxious pets and slows down fast eaters.
features: Built-in water bowl, slow-feed zones and textured licking areas
Strong suction cups keep it on the floor, tub or wall
Food-grade silicone, dishwasher-safe and freezer-safe
Great for baths, grooming, nail trims and storms

products.title: Collapsible Camping Wash Basin (9 L)
products.blurb: A full-size dish tub that folds down to 1.5 in thick.
features: About 9 L capacity for dishes, produce, laundry or ice and drinks
Collapses flat to roughly 1.5 in for RVs, campers and small kitchens
Sturdy PP rim with soft TPR walls and carry handles
Food-safe and easy to rinse clean

products.title: Anti-Curl Rug Corner Grippers (16-Piece Set)
products.blurb: Flatten curled rug corners and stop slipping for good.
features: Triangle grippers hold rug corners flat on hard floors
Reusable, washable sticky grip pad; no residue on floors
Thin (about 0.09 in) so they hide under the rug
Set of 16, enough for multiple rugs or extra corners

products.title: Rechargeable Magnetic COB Work Light
products.blurb: Bright hands-free light for the garage, engine bay or campsite.
features: Wide COB LED panel with 3 lighting modes
Magnetic base sticks to car bodies, toolboxes and steel shelves
Fold-out stand and hook for hanging or standing
Rechargeable built-in battery; water-resistant housing
products.shipping_note: Built-in lithium battery: some carriers and destinations restrict shipping.

products.title: Window Track & Gap Cleaning Brush (3-Pack)
products.blurb: Gets the gunk out of window tracks, tile grout and sliding-door rails.
features: Stiff, slim bristles fit narrow tracks and crevices
Angled head reaches corners standard brushes miss
Hanging loop handle for easy storage
3 brushes for kitchen, bathroom and windows

products.title: Insulated Outdoor Faucet Covers (2-Pack)
products.blurb: Protect outdoor spigots from freezing and bursting this winter.
features: 420D waterproof Oxford shell with thick cotton insulation
Drawstring and hook-and-loop strap seal it tight to the wall
About 7.1 x 10.6 in, fits most standard outdoor faucets
Reusable winter after winter; set of 2
